import { insert as _insert, child as _child, next as _next, txt as _txt, toDisplayString as _toDisplayString, setText as _setText, setInsertionState as _setInsertionState, renderEffect as _renderEffect, createFor as _createFor, template as _template } from 'vue';
const t0 = _template("<tr><th>Name</th></tr>")
const t1 = _template("<tr><td> </td></tr>")
const t2 = _template("<tr><td> </td></tr>")
const t3 = _template("<td> </td>")
const t4 = _template("<table class=\"grid\"></table>")
const t5 = _template("<table><thead><tr><th>Note</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td> </td></tr></tbody></table>")

function render(_ctx, $props, $emit, $attrs, $slots) {
  const n2 = t4()
  const n12 = t5()
  const n0 = t0()
  const n1 = t3()
  const n11 = _next(_child(n12))
  const n13 = _child(n11)
  const n14 = _child(n13)
  const x1 = _txt(n1)
  const x14 = _txt(n14)
  _insert(n0, n2)
  _setInsertionState(n2, 1)
  const n3 = _createFor(() => (_ctx.rows), (_for_item0) => {
    const n6 = t1()
    const n5 = _child(n6)
    const x5 = _txt(n5)
    _renderEffect(() => _setText(x5, _toDisplayString(_for_item0.value.name)))
    return n6
  }, (row) => (row.id), 8 /* IS_SINGLE_NODE */)
  _setInsertionState(n2, 2)
  const n7 = _createFor(() => (_ctx.extra), (_for_item0) => {
    const n10 = t2()
    const n9 = _child(n10)
    const x9 = _txt(n9)
    _renderEffect(() => _setText(x9, _toDisplayString(_for_item0.value.name)))
    return n10
  }, (row) => (row.id), 8 /* IS_SINGLE_NODE */)
  _insert(n1, n2)
  _renderEffect(() => {
    _setText(x1, _toDisplayString(_ctx.total))
    _setText(x14, _toDisplayString(_ctx.note))
  })
  return [n2, n12]
}
const _sfc_main = { __vapor: true }
_sfc_main.render = render
export default _sfc_main
